outcome: Abnormal bleeding (defined as 1500 mL or more)
cohort: 947 women who had preterm emergency cesarean deliveries and 1056 women who had full-term emergency cesarean deliveries
finding: Preterm cesarean delivery was associated with a significantly higher risk of maternal bleeding, blood transfusion, and postoperative antibiotic use compared to term cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Among preterm deliveries, classical incision was associated with an increased rate of blood transfusion and need for antibiotic treatment compared to other incision types.
